name: Nishinoshima (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nishinoshima town emblem in green: a ring of concentric arcs beneath two stylised leaves.
history: Municipal flag of Nishinoshima, a town in Shimane Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 1971.

features.role: Nishinoshima town emblem — a ring of concentric arcs beneath two stylised leaves
